basis: Every row is a VHCF subgrant under the Provider Interoperability subinitiative, paid out of the state's first-tier award to VHCF. VHCF's release names the 25 awards as its own RHT Provider Interoperability grants; DMAS's FSRS subaward RHT26-008-VHCF to VIRGINIA HEALTH CARE FOUNDATION ($16,073,769, 2026-07-24) reads 'PROVIDER INTEROPERABILITY SUBINITIATIVE: PROVIDES FUNDS AND SUPPORT TO RURAL PROVIDERS TO ASSESS AND UPGRADE IT, EHR, AND CYBERSECURITY SYST...'. The 25 awards ($14,390,000) are inside that subaward.

Every row is a VHCF subgrant under the Provider Productivity subinitiative, paid out of the state's first-tier award to VHCF. VHCF's release ('VHCF Invests $8.6 Million...') names the 23 awards; DMAS's FSRS subaward RHT26-007-VHCF to VIRGINIA HEALTH CARE FOUNDATION ($9,891,550, 2026-07-24) reads 'PROVIDER PRODUCTIVITY SUBINITIATIVE: PROVIDES FUNDS TO RURAL PROVIDERS AND HEALTH SYSTEMS TO ADOPT AND INTEGRATE DIGITAL PRODUCTIVITY...'. The 23 awards ($8,644,000) are inside that subaward.
